page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T95 processor clocked at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 8.0 GB of memory provisioned per core. There are no onboard graphics processing units included.

Networking performance features a baseline throughput of 16 Gbps, facilitating predictable communication across clustered deployments or external application tiers. The instance does not include integrated local block storage, requiring instances to rely entirely on external cloud storage volumes for operating system disks and persistent operational data. Complementary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the provisioned hardware configuration.

Resource allocation on the ecs.r9ae.8xlarge emphasizes high memory density per compute thread without bundling local storage hardware. This architectural design yields qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive enterprise software, avoiding the capital overhead of local NVMe arrays when persistent remote storage is preferred. Primary workloads suited for this profile include large-scale in-memory databases, Redis caching clusters, high-capacity distributed data processing, and enterprise application backends requiring expansive working memory.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual instance configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a 1:8 core-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T95 processor operating at 2.25 GHz on the KVM hypervisor, this server provides a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without discrete GPUs or integrated local disk storage. All filesystem operations rely on external network-attached volumes. By directing hardware resources toward high RAM density rather than attached NVMe drives or graphic accelerators, the instance offers a focused infrastructure footprint for memory-bound applications. The ecs.r9ae.8xlarge is suited for in-memory caches, large operational databases, enterprise ERP backends, and distributed big data analytics.
